scope: Read-only review after engine/design lock; no author action, bundle mutation, generator execution, target payload, or generated table access.

reviewer_checks.name: Internal web failure classification
reviewer_checks.detail: Direct calls returned halted for task_or_provenance_violation, interrupted_command and local_or_parser_failure.

reviewer_checks.name: Ordinary acquisition failure classification
reviewer_checks.detail: Direct calls returned active for encrypted PDF, PDF page limit, invalid/unsupported PDF, PDF parse timeout, HTTP403 and network timeout.

reviewer_checks.name: Post-acquisition integrity verification
reviewer_checks.detail: Code inspection confirms web.verify(root) runs before new acquisition bindings are recorded; verification exceptions produce halted status.

reviewer_checks.name: Closure bound to controller actions
reviewer_checks.detail: Closure derives successful finish and execution slots from verified session actions, rejects unexpected execution files, and checks exact slot set plus cardinality.

reviewer_checks.name: Evaluator schedule checks
reviewer_checks.detail: Invented in-memory schedule accepted; extra disk run, duplicate slot, changed candidate, changed final selection and changed run inventory all rejected.

reviewer_checks.name: Independent recomputation duplicate guard
reviewer_checks.detail: Code inspection confirms both len(rows)==len(expected_slots) and exact candidate/seed set equality.

reviewer_checks.name: Two feedback layers and artifact binding
reviewer_checks.detail: Existing successful feedback requires strict plus descriptive collectors; both receipts are recorded and verified.

upstream_test_evidence.note: Root-reported focused test result; test code inspected, full suite not repeated.

not_assessed: Author candidate quality or source selection
Current run completion or target-analysis usefulness
Public export content approval or remote publication
immutability: No engine, task, protocol, config, lock, old artifact or author-bundle file modified.
